questions.stem: 由於氣候變遷，要確保農民所種的足以養活全國人民並不容易。
questions.answer: Because of climate change, it is not easy to ensure that what farmers grow is sufficient to feed the whole population.
accepted_answers: Due to climate change, it is not easy to make sure that what farmers grow is enough to feed the entire nation.
As a result of climate change, it is hard to ensure that what farmers grow is enough to feed everyone in the country.

patterns: what 名詞子句（農民所種的＝what farmers grow，當 that 子句的主詞）
虛主詞 It ＋形容詞＋不定詞（要確保…並不容易）

questions.stem: 因此，種植耐旱作物可以提高糧食產量，使農民在少雨的年份也免於重大損失。
questions.answer: Therefore, growing crops that can survive droughts can increase food production, protecting farmers from heavy losses even in years of low rainfall.
accepted_answers: Therefore, planting drought-resistant crops can help raise food production, saving farmers from serious losses even in years with little rain.
Therefore, growing crops that can resist drought can boost food production, sparing farmers heavy losses even in years when it rarely rains.

patterns: 動名詞（或不定詞）片語當主詞（種植耐旱作物：Growing … can …）
句尾分詞片語表結果（…，使農民…免於重大損失）

1.explanation_zh: 「要確保…並不容易」用虛主詞 It is not easy to ensure that …，比把長長的不定詞放在句首自然。「農民所種的」後面沒有名詞，英文用 what farmers grow（＝the things that farmers grow）當 that 子句的主詞，what 子句視為單數，動詞用 is。「足以…」是 be sufficient／enough to VR；「全國人民」寫 the whole population 或 everyone in the country。
evidence: 要確保農民所種的足以養活全國人民並不容易
1.strategy_zh: 先決定主幹 It is not easy to ensure that＋子句；再把子句的主詞「農民所種的」寫成 what farmers grow。
hints: 切成四段：由於氣候變遷／要確保（…並不容易）／農民所種的／足以養活全國人民
標的詞彙：climate（氣候）、ensure（確保）、farmer（農民）、grow（種植）、feed（養活）
句型框架：It is not easy to ensure that + what + S + V + is sufficient to VR …

2.explanation_zh: 「因此」承接第 1 句，用 Therefore,。「種植耐旱作物」是動詞片語當主詞，英文用動名詞 Growing（或 Planting）…，後面接 can increase；「耐旱的作物」可寫 drought-resistant crops 或 crops that can survive droughts。「，使農民…免於重大損失」是前面這件事帶來的結果，用句尾分詞片語 protecting／saving farmers from heavy losses；「在少雨的年份也…」放在句尾，寫 even in years of low rainfall（或 even in years with little rain、even in dry years）。
evidence: 種植耐旱作物可以提高糧食產量
使農民在少雨的年份也免於重大損失
2.strategy_zh: 先寫動名詞主詞 Growing drought-resistant crops，再接 can increase food production；最後在逗號後用 protecting farmers from … 帶出結果，時間放句尾。
hints: 切成四段：種植耐旱作物／可以提高糧食產量／使農民／在少雨的年份也免於重大損失
標的詞彙：grow（種植）、crop（作物）、drought（乾旱）、production（產量）、loss（損失）
句型框架：Therefore, V-ing … + can + V …, protecting + O + from + N + even in …

1.translation: Because of climate change, it is not easy to ensure that what farmers grow is enough to feed the whole country.
1.explanation_zh: 「由於」用 Because of 接名詞；「要確保…並不容易」用 it is not easy to ensure that ...；「農民所種的」用 what 名詞子句 what farmers grow 當主詞；「足以養活全國人民」用 be enough to feed（全國人民寫 the whole country／everyone in the country 都可）。

2.translation: Therefore, growing drought-resistant crops can increase food production, protecting farmers from serious losses even in years with little rain.
2.explanation_zh: 「種植耐旱作物」用動名詞片語當主詞 growing drought-resistant crops；「使農民…免於重大損失」是提高產量帶來的結果，用句尾分詞 protecting farmers from ...；「在少雨的年份也」用 even in years with little rain。

1.translation: Because of climate change, it is not easy to ensure that what farmers grow is enough to feed the whole nation.
1.explanation_zh: 「由於」用 Because of；「確保」用 ensure that；「農民所種的」用名詞子句 what farmers grow 當主詞；「足以養活」用 be enough to feed。

2.translation: Therefore, growing drought-resistant crops can increase food production and keep farmers from suffering major losses even in years with little rain.
2.explanation_zh: 動名詞 growing 當主詞；「耐旱作物」用複合形容詞 drought-resistant；「使農民免於重大損失」用 keep farmers from suffering；「少雨的年份」用 years with little rain。

issues_zh: PART 沒有被中文引出：「…可以提高糧食產量，使農民…免於重大損失」我自然譯成「can increase food production and keep farmers from suffering major losses…」（兩個動詞並列），沒有用句尾分詞片語；並列寫法同樣自然、正確，中文並沒有迫使人用分詞。
第 3、4 部分的 accepted 只收分詞寫法（protecting／saving／sparing／keeping farmers…），不收「and keep／protect farmers from…」或「so that farmers…」，我這個正確的譯法因此落在可接受寫法之外。建議在 accepted 補並列寫法並把 PART 視為加分句型，或把中文改成較能引出分詞片語的寫法。
